fullPassage: To find the hidden potential in teams, instead of brainstorming, we're better off shifting to a process called brainwriting. The initial steps are solo. You start by asking everyone to generate ideas separately. Next, you pool them and share them anonymously among the group. To preserve independent judgment, each member evaluates them on their own. Only then does the team come together to select and refine the most promising options. By developing and assessing ideas individually before choosing and elaborating them, teams can surface and advance possibilities that might not get attention otherwise. This brainwriting process makes sure that all ideas are brought to the table and all voices are brought into the conversation. It is especially effective in groups that struggle to achieve collective intelligence.

❌ ① 회의 장소를 실제 탁자로 옮기는 것: 'bring to the table'은 비유적 관용구이지 실제 탁자가 아님

❌ ② 아이디어를 평가 없이 즉시 폐기하는 것: 오히려 반대(모두 포함)

✅ ③ 모든 아이디어가 숨겨지지 않고 논의에 제시되는 것: 'all ideas are brought to the table'은 모든 아이디어가 논의 석상에 올려진다는 뜻 ← 정답

❌ ④ 리더가 혼자 최종 결정을 내리는 것: 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: bring to the table = (아이디어 등을) 논의에 제시하다

questions.passage: To find the hidden potential in teams, instead of brainstorming, we're better off shifting to a process called brainwriting. The initial steps are solo. You start by asking everyone to generate ideas separately. Next, you pool <u>them</u> and share them anonymously among the group. To preserve independent judgment, each member evaluates them on their own. Only then does the team come together to select and refine the most promising options. By developing and assessing ideas individually before choosing and elaborating them, teams can surface and advance possibilities that might not get attention otherwise. This brainwriting process makes sure that all ideas are brought to the table and all voices are brought into the conversation. It is especially effective in groups that struggle to achieve collective intelligence.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: them = 아이디어(ideas)
det.analysis:
✅ ① 구성원들이 생성한 아이디어: 'you pool them and share them'에서 them은 앞 문장의 ideas(각자 생성한 아이디어)를 가리킴 ← 정답

❌ ② 팀의 구성원들: them은 사람이 아니라 아이디어

❌ ③ 익명의 평가자들: 본문에 그런 대상 없음

❌ ④ 최종적으로 선택된 선택지들: 선택은 이후 단계이며, 여기 them은 공유 전의 아이디어
det.tip: pool/share them = 아이디어를 모으고 공유하다

팀의 구성원들

det.korean: 빈칸: share them anonymously among the group(집단 내에서 익명으로 공유하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① present them with their names attached(이름을 붙여 제시하다): 익명성과 반대

❌ ② keep them hidden from everyone else(모두에게 숨겨 두다): 공유한다는 문맥과 반대

❌ ③ rank them by the team leader's preference(리더 선호로 순위를 매기다): 독립 판단과 반대

✅ ④ share them anonymously among the group(집단 내에서 익명으로 공유하다): 아이디어를 모아 익명으로 공유해 독립적 판단을 지킨다 ← 정답
